jobs.title: Junior Recruiter (German-Speaking)
jobs.description: About Us At Rapid Pioneers, we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals. About the Company You will be joining a fast-growing wellness and massage company that currently operates in five German cities and is expanding to seven. The company is known for a high-quality, above-and-beyond approach to customer service, and its People team is scaling hiring quickly to keep pace with that growth. This hire sits at the very start of the recruitment funnel, where speed and a great first impression make all the difference. The Role As a Junior Recruiter, you will be the first voice candidates hear from the company. You will call new applicants quickly, introduce the opportunity with energy and confidence, and run short screening calls so the strongest people move forward without delay. This is an entry point into recruiting, and no previous recruiting experience is needed. You’ll work closely with the Head of People, splitting your time between the Berlin office and home. It’s ideal for someone who loves talking to people, moves fast, and wants to learn recruiting from the ground up. Key Responsibilities Call new applicants within 24 hours to keep interest high Give a clear, friendly phone introduction to the company and the role Run short screening calls and pass qualified candidates to the next stage Handle a high volume of outbound calls and follow-ups so good candidates never go cold Cover evening and weekend shifts to keep response times fast Keep candidate information accurate and up to date in Personio Share feedback with the Head of People to improve call scripts and results Ideal Candidate Fluent German (essential) Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Based in Berlin with the right to work in Germany, able to work hybrid from the office Available for evenings and weekends as

jobs.description: At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As our GEO Manager , you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems. You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions. About your new role GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives. AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders. jobs.title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Darum geht es Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen oder neu vermieten. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen. Was du machst Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufs- oder Vermietungsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache. Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment. Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen. Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber. Was du mitbringst 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz. Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal. jobs.description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. jobs.description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The role Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations. You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works. jobs.title: Research Software Engineering Intern (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend. The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Dann bau mit uns den Creator-Kanal für eine Marke auf, die gerade von der Café-Theke in die Küche zieht. Wer wir sind Purēcha ist unsere Latte-Konzentrat-Marke – Matcha, Chai und Ube, flüssig statt Pulver, in zehn Sekunden fertig. Bisher läuft Purēcha in über 1000 Cafés. Jetzt bringen wir es als Latte-Trio direkt zu Endkund:innen, und dafür brauchen wir Creator, die unser Produkt in ihrer Küche zeigen. Hinter Purēcha steht die Pure Beverage GmbH aus Kiel: ein Team von rund 15 Leuten, das Getränke entwickelt und in der eigenen Manufaktur in Neumünster abfüllt. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die Person, die unseren Creator-Kanal von null aufbaut – mit eigener Verantwortung, nicht als Zuarbeit. Creator finden: Du recherchierst Micro-Creator (3–50k Follower) in den Bereichen Matcha, Home-Café, Food und Lifestyle auf Instagram und TikTok und baust eine Pipeline von 100+ passenden Profilen auf. Ansprechen und gewinnen: Du schreibst Creator persönlich an, verhandelst Konditionen im vorgegebenen Rahmen und bringst jeden Monat 15–20 Kooperationen zum Abschluss. jobs.title: Sales Controller (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Aufgabenbereich Unterstützung bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen, einschließlich Abstimmungen, Periodenabgrenzungen und Prüfung von Buchungen. Erstellung und Prüfung von Abweichungsanalysen auf Basis von Ist-, Plan- und Forecast-Zahlen. Pflege und Auswertung von Kennzahlen und Reports für Sales und Marketing. Mitarbeit bei Forecasts und Planungsprozessen. Prüfung von Rechnungen und Kosten sowie Klärung offener Fragen mit den Fachbereichen. Dokumentation der Abschlussschritte für eine strukturierte Übergabe. Qualifikationen Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder Rechnungswesen, insbesondere mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen. Sichere Kenntnisse in SAP FI/CO, insbesondere in Kostenstellen, Innenaufträgen und Reporting. Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Pivot-Tabellen, SVERWEIS/XLOOKUP und Datenabgleiche. Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, nach kurzer Einarbeitung direkt einsatzbereit zu sein. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Das ist ein Plus Kenntnisse in Power BI, SQ

Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost. Communications & Data Handling Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts . Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures. Integration & Interface Management Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.). jobs.title: Head of Growth (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 50 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin. Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Head of Growth (f/m/d) to join our team. Your role In this role, you own business development and lead our Sales and Marketing teams, reporting directly to our Co-CEO. You work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance. The role is deliberately broad: you are here to build what does not exist yet, not to administer what does. Tasks Lead Sales & Key Account Management directly, plus Marketing and Business Development: set shared targets, define the handover from demand generation to pipeline, and make performance measurable. Build the internal processes a growing go-to-market organisation needs, including planning, forecasting, target systems, and reporting that gives management a reliable view of pipeline, conversion, and marketing contribution. Define product and pricing standards, such as price models and discount guidelines, together with our Head of Products, and ensure they are applied consistently. Feed structured market signals (recurring customer needs, lost-deal reasons, unserved demand) into product innovation, prioritized with Product and the C-Level. Build out stablecoins and institutional tokenization custody solutions and open up new customer segments, from market validation to a repeatable route to market.

jobs.description: Location: Remote in Europe Salary: Competitive base + Commission About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise. Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry. Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. The Team ⭐️ Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast. About the Role 🤔 You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. jobs.description: Help shape the future of robotics in construction. ABOUT XYZ REALITY XYZ Reality created the world’s first and only engineering-grade augmented reality solution, purpose-built for the construction industry. Our holographic technology sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset and hardhat, and is used on live projects to ensure schemes are delivered on time and on budget. XYZ has grown to over 150 staff across the UK, US and Europe, and works with mission-critical organisations and construction companies to deliver major projects. THE ROLE Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks. We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you. This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring. jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description: The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog s security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog s security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.   We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.   The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model s outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.   At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it bring

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description: AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog s AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog s shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time. Specifically, you ll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog s agents learn in. GenSim doesn t replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog s own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against. The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That s the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland. Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen. De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart. · Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie. · Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content). · Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales. · Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen. · Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata. · Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat. · Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in. · Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV). Wat biedt Snelstart jou? · Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring. · 30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur) · Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland. · Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage. · Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten. · Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid. · Een betrokken en dynamisch team. Wat is de procedure? Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelS

jobs.description: Every order a Suitsupply customer places, online, in a store, or through customer service, has to be captured, understood and carried all the way through to delivery or return. As Junior Product Manager for IT Fulfillment, you will help build and improve the services that make that happen: the order flows, data and interfaces that connect our webstore, our stores, our warehouses and our customer service teams. You will work in a small team inside the IT Fulfillment domain, alongside the Group Product Manager and our own engineers. The Group Product Manager shapes the functional direction with the business and sets priorities; together you turn it into clear requirements, well-defined tickets and working software, built with engineers and AI agents. This is a technical product role: we build our own services, so you will spend your time in data models, interfaces and requirements rather than managing a vendor’s roadmap. You start close to delivery, with support while you learn the domain, and grow into owning more of the roadmap. What you will do Turn mapped-out functional flows into clear, buildable work: technical requirements, acceptance criteria and user stories that engineers and AI agents can pick up without coming back with questions. Own the detail as both product manager and business analyst: the data model, the way systems talk to each other, and the edge cases nobody thought of yet. Break large changes into chunks that can be built, tested and released safely, and keep the backlog in a state where work can start at any moment. Work with engineers day to day in refinement, planning, reviews and releases, and use our AI tooling to draft, structure and pressure-test the work before it reaches them. Design our order data and interfaces so that AI agents can read, reason over and act on them as reliably as our own systems do. jobs.title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
jobs.description: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! Jouw rol Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate. Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren). Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s. Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Wie zijn wij? Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. jobs.description: Job Description RECO is actief in de verhuur en dienstverlening rondom de bouwplaats, onder andere op het gebied van tijdelijke huisvesting, energie, verlichting, steigerbouw, verticaal transport en bouwplaatsbeveiliging. De bouwplaats wordt steeds digitaler. Data, IoT, AI, SaaS-oplossingen, sensoren en realtime monitoring bieden mogelijkheden om niet alleen afzonderlijke producten digitaal te ondersteunen, maar de bouwplaats als geheel slimmer, veiliger en efficiënter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Hoe kan RECO een schaalbaar digitaal platform/concept ontwikkelen waarmee bouwplaatsen integraal digitaal kunnen worden gemonitord, aangestuurd en geoptimaliseerd, waarbij SaaS, AI, IoT en bestaande RECO-diensten samenkomen? Daarbij staat niet één afzonderlijk product centraal, maar de vraag: Hoe ziet de bouwplaats van de toekomst eruit en welke digitale rol kan RECO daarin vervullen? Het doel is om een conceptueel uitgewerkt en onderbouwd digitaliseringsconcept op te leveren dat RECO kan gebruiken als basis voor verdere ontwikkeling en eventuele realisatie. De opdracht moet nadrukkelijk voorkomen dat er alleen een theoretisch adviesrapport ontstaat. Je wordt uitgedaagd om hands-on met technologie te werken en waar mogelijk een werkend prototype of proof-of-concept te ontwikkelen. Requirements Wat breng jij mee? 👍 HBO opleding in Software Development of Engineering, ICT, Technische Informatica, Business IT & Management, AI & Data Science of Applied Data Science 👍 Analytisch sterk met een ondernemende instelling; 👍 Interesse in AI, SaaS en cloud 👍 Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling; 👍 Kunnen vertalen van klantproblemen naar digitale oplossingen; 👍 Zelfstandig onderzoek kunnen uitvoeren; 👍 Bereidheid om een prototype daadwerkelijk te bouwen. 👍 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met: ✅ Een goede stagevergoeding. ✅ Begeleiding door ervaren professionals, dicht bij de business. ✅ Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en onderzoek. ✅ Werken

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Bau die KI für eine Stadt, die einfach funktioniert. Ein Vorgang bleibt liegen, weil Wissen nur in einzelnen Köpfen steckt. Mitarbeitende suchen Informationen über mehrere Systeme hinweg. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben kosten Zeit, die für die Anliegen der Menschen fehlt. Bei summ ai wollen wir das ändern. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Software für Prozessmanagement und Automatisierung im öffentlichen Sektor. Unser Ziel: Verwaltungswissen zugänglich machen, Abläufe vereinfachen und Routinearbeit automatisieren – mit Software, die Menschen gerne nutzen und die sich mit ihren Anforderungen weiterentwickelt. Dafür arbeiten wir eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen. Wir verstehen ihre Probleme, bringen Lösungen früh in den Einsatz und verbessern sie anhand echter Nutzung. Als AI Engineer gestaltest du diesen Weg mit: von der Produktidee über die technische Umsetzung bis zur Frage, ob die KI im Alltag zuverlässig hilft. Deine Aufgaben Probleme verstehen und Lösungen gestalten: Du sprichst direkt mit Kunden, hinterfragst Anforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen, die du früh mit Nutzern überprüfst. KI-Funktionen und Agenten bauen: Du verantwortest die Umsetzung vom Interface bis zum Backend. Du verbindest Modelle mit Datenquellen und Werkzeugen und gestaltest Prompts, Kontext und Agentenabläufe. KI-Qualität verbessern: Du analysierst Fehler aus der Nutzung, baust Evaluationen auf und vergleichst Modelle hinsichtlich Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Kosten. Du kannst zeigen, ob eine Änderung tatsächlich besser funktioniert. Bis in den Betrieb Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bringst Funktionen live, beobachtest ihre Nutzung und entwickelst sie weiter. Zu deiner Arbeit gehören auch Deployment, Monitoring und die nötige Cloud-Infrastruktur. Unsere Entwicklung voranbringen: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge, automatisierst wiederkehrende Arbeit und hilfst dem Team, schneller zu verlässlichen Ergebnissen zu kommen. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und die Fähigkei

jobs.title: (Senior) SEO & GEO Manager // AI Music Video Platform
jobs.description: Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Organic search has historically been our most important acquisition channel: product pages, free tools and landing pages in many languages that bring musicians and creators to us every day. It has never had a dedicated owner. At the same time, search is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and more and more discovery happens inside AI answers on Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity. We're looking for our first Senior SEO & GEO Manager to own organic acquisition end to end: decide what we build and why, make it genuinely useful, get it shipped, and show what it changed in signups and paying customers. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership. You'll work directly with the founder, with our engineers on implementation, and with our content and creator team. We're looking for people with high agency and a bias to action. Tasks Own our organic search strategy and a prioritized roadmap: which pages, tools and fixes, in what order, and the business reason behind each Diagnose and prioritize technical SEO on a modern Next.js site - crawling, indexing, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, canonicals, structured data, hreflang and speed - and ship - where possible - updates to it yourself with AI Research search intent and turn it into acquisition pages and free tools that genuinely help musicians, labels and creators, and that bring them into the product Write, edit and improve English landing pages and briefs yourself, and keep quality high across our localized pages Expand our approach to AI search: define the prompts that matter, measure where we appear and which sources AI answers rely on, run documented

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. jobs.title: Head of Growth (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 50 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin. Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Head of Growth (f/m/d) to join our team. Your role In this role, you own business development and lead our Sales and Marketing teams, reporting directly to our Co-CEO. You work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance. The role is deliberately broad: you are here to build what does not exist yet, not to administer what does. Tasks Lead Sales & Key Account Management directly, plus Marketing and Business Development: set shared targets, define the handover from demand generation to pipeline, and make performance measurable. Build the internal processes a growing go-to-market organisation needs, including planning, forecasting, target systems, and reporting that gives management a reliable view of pipeline, conversion, and marketing contribution. Define product and pricing standards, such as price models and discount guidelines, together with our Head of Products, and ensure they are applied consistently. Feed structured market signals (recurring customer needs, lost-deal reasons, unserved demand) into product innovation, prioritized with Product and the C-Level. Build out stablecoins and institutional tokenization custody solutions and open up new customer segments, from market validation to a repeatable route to market.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working.
